assessment_scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not the model intelligence. These are user-reported signals, not independently observed execution results.

method.unit: Entry, not an independent session or attempt
method.frequency_rule: Task volume establishes coverage only. Weakness requires explicit friction. Absence of reported friction does not establish success.

rating_definitions.Critical: Repeated explicit reports of blocked execution within an eligible category; no claim about permanent capability.
rating_definitions.Weak: Explicit quality friction within an eligible category.
rating_definitions.Developing: Explicit evidence of partial progress or incomplete capability within an eligible category.
rating_definitions.Covered: An eligible workflow is substantively represented without explicit friction; this does not certify performance.

strongest_measured_task_category.basis: Strongest observed verification-oriented task framing: all four entries request evidence or verification, with no reported friction. This is a relative workflow-coverage result, not demonstrated task competence.
strongest_measured_task_category.demonstrated_performance_strength: Cannot be established without assistant outputs or verified outcomes.

categories.evidence: All four requests explicitly require primary evidence, verification, or citations. Coverage describes the requested workflow only; successful execution is unobserved.
One interface review request; below the two-entry threshold. Render command failures are execution evidence, not visual-quality evidence.
No explicit code implementation or code review entries. Command troubleshooting alone does not establish coding evidence.
One correction explicitly reports unsuitable tone and generic wording; two other writing requests supply context without proving success or failure.

Two render timeout reports, one permission-denied automation report, and one server-tool error report indicate blocked execution. One timeout report explicitly indicates recurrence. Root causes and recovery are unobserved.

surprising_weakness.finding: Execution reliability is the clearest gap despite the sample emphasis on evidence-based research.
surprising_weakness.evidence: Four entries explicitly report blocked tools, including repeated timeouts, a permission failure, and a server error.
surprising_weakness.qualification: Reports may reflect infrastructure rather than agent behavior; the sample does not establish causation or an overall failure rate.

recommendation_status: Relevant skills, not confirmed missing installations. Recommendations are hypotheses for improvement, not proof of effectiveness.

recommended_skills.reason: Diagnose environment and permission failures before attributing them to capability.
Apply recovery and final-result verification to interrupted or timed-out work.
Address the explicit complaint about generic wording and unsuitable tone.
Check audience and register for correspondence with explicit tone friction.
